_readme: Single-location offers, entered by hand on 2026-11-07. Every place lists where its address/phone and its coordinates came from. Addresses and phones come only from the place's own official site (or Wikidata where the official site refused automated access). Where no source gives an exact street address, 'a' is empty and the point is the Census Gazetteer internal point of the town: the card then says the exact spot is on the offer page. Nothing here is guessed.
